## =================
## PRDM16 dimension and frequency correlation analysis
## =================

## S1:Correlation between all functional sites and latitude
chm13: PRDM16	chr1	2571244	2943423	372180
hg38: PRDM16 chr1:3069168-3438621 (length: 369,453)


```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)

inputDir <- "/Users/Aoyue/project_pos/APG_archaicDNA/003_result/adaptiveIntrogressionAllele_byAoyue_2025-12-31/PRDM16/1KGP_HGDP"

df0 <- read_xlsx("/Users/Aoyue/project_pos/APG_archaicDNA/002_dataAnalysis/011_adaptiveIntrogression/007_vepAnnotation/003/PRDM16_N12.xlsx") 

target_genes <- c("PRDM16")
dfveppp <-  read_excel("/Users/Aoyue/project_pos/APG_archaicDNA/002_dataAnalysis/011_adaptiveIntrogression/007_vepAnnotation/003/PRDM16_N12.xlsx")
# dfpara_intro <- readxl::read_xlsx("/Users/Aoyue/project_pos/APG_archaicDNA/002_dataAnalysis/011_adaptiveIntrogression/008_validateBy1KGP/001_introgressionSites_2calSelection.xlsx",sheet = "Merge")

### 3890694 3890886
df1 <- df0 %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Chr = `#CHROM`) %>% 
  filter(Consequence %in% c("regulatory_region_variant","TF_binding_site_variant")) %>% 
  # filter(Consequence %in% c("missense_variant") ) %>% 
  distinct(Chr, POS, REF, ALT, POS_HG38, NeanAltai, GeneName, BlockID,Uploaded_variation,.keep_all = T)

df_target <- df1 %>% 
  # filter(POS_HG38 ==  3320163) %>% 
  mutate(a=1)


############ 
outfile_combine <- "/Users/Aoyue/project_pos/APG_archaicDNA/002_dataAnalysis/011_adaptiveIntrogression/008_validateBy1KGP/004_Lat_VS_frequency/001_PRDM16_pos_correlationStatistic.txt"
df_combined <- tibble()

dfpara0 <- df_target

for(i in 1:nrow(dfpara0)){
  geneName0 <- dfpara0$GeneName[i]
  BlockID <- dfpara0$BlockID[i]
  pos_selected <- dfpara0$POS_HG38[i]
  
  Existing_variation <- dfveppp %>% filter(POS_HG38 == pos_selected) %>% 
    distinct(POS_HG38, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% dplyr::select(Existing_variation) %>% pull()
  
  Uploaded_variation <- dfveppp %>% filter(POS_HG38 == pos_selected) %>% 
    distinct(POS_HG38, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% dplyr::select(Uploaded_variation) %>% pull()
  
  geneName <- str_c(geneName0, "_", str_replace_all(Uploaded_variation, "/", "_"), "_", Existing_variation)
  
  ################## para2: input & output
  plotPath <- fs::path("/Users/Aoyue/Documents/", 
                       str_c("Correlation_hgdp_1kgp_", geneName, "_", BlockID, "_posHG38_", pos_selected, ".pdf"))
  ##################
  
  inDir <- "/Users/Aoyue/project_pos/APG_archaicDNA/003_result/adaptiveIntrogressionAllele_byAoyue_2025-12-31/PRDM16/1KGP_HGDP"
  infile <- file.path(inDir, str_c("HGDP+1KGP_", geneName, "_", BlockID, "_posHG38_", pos_selected, "_alleleFre_byPop.txt")) 
  
  df3 <- read_tsv(infile)
  
  df4 <- df3 %>% 
    filter(Long > 95 & Lat > 5) %>% 
    filter(Pop != "Han")
  
  # Calculate correlation
cor_test <- cor.test(df4$Introgressed, df4$Lat, method = "pearson")
cor_coef <- round(cor_test$estimate, 3)
p_value <- ifelse(cor_test$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", 
                 sprintf("%.3f", cor_test$p.value))

### Record correlation coefficient and p-value, output to table
dfs <- tibble(Uploaded_variation = Uploaded_variation, Cor_coef = cor_coef, P_value = p_value)
df_combined <- bind_rows(df_combined, dfs)

# Create custom theme
theme_custom <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5,
                                margin = margin(b = 15)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "plain"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
    )
}

# Create aesthetically pleasing color scheme
color_palette <- c(
  "EAS" = "#2E8B57",  # Sea green
  "SEA" = "#4682B4",  # Steel blue
  "SAS" = "#D2691E",  # Chocolate
  "EUR" = "#9370DB",  # Medium purple
  "AFR" = "#DC143C"   # Crimson
)

# Create plot
p <- ggplot(df4, aes(x = Introgressed, y = Lat, color = Anc)) +
  # Confidence interval
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", 
              formula = y ~ x, 
              se = TRUE, 
              color = "#4A708B",  # Steel blue
              fill = "#87CEEB",   # Light sky blue
              alpha = 0.2,
              linewidth = 0.8,
              linetype = "solid") +
  
  # Scatter points
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.8, shape = 19) +
  
  # Regression line
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", 
              formula = y ~ x, 
              se = FALSE, 
              color = "#2F4F4F",  # Dark slate gray
              linewidth = 1.2,
              linetype = "solid") +
  
  # Add text labels (Pop names)
  geom_text(aes(label = Pop), 
            size = 3.5, 
            color = "black",
            fontface = "bold",
            hjust = 0, vjust = 0, 
            nudge_x = 0.005, nudge_y = 0.3,
            check_overlap = FALSE) +
  
  # Add correlation statistic label
  annotate("text",
           x = min(df4$Introgressed) + 0.02,
           y = max(df4$Lat) - 2,
           label = paste0("R = ", cor_coef, "\n", 
                         "P ", p_value),
           size = 5,
           color = "#2F4F4F",
           fontface = "bold",
           hjust = 0,
           lineheight = 0.9) +
  
  # Colors, axes, and labels
  scale_color_manual(values = color_palette,
                     name = "Ancestry group") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(min(df4$Introgressed) - 0.02, 
                               max(df4$Introgressed) + 0.05),
                     breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                     labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min(df4$Lat) - 2, max(df4$Lat) + 2),
                     breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
  
  # Title and axis labels
  labs(
    title = geneName,
    subtitle = paste("Analysis of", nrow(df4), "populations from different ancestry groups"),
    x = "Frequency of introgressed sites",
    y = "Latitude (°N)",
    caption = paste("Data source:", 
                   paste(unique(df4$Anc), collapse = ", "),
                   "ancestry groups | n =", nrow(df4), "populations")
  ) +
  
  # Apply custom theme
  theme_custom() +
  
  # Add gridline aesthetics
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray92", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5)
  )

# Display plot
print(p)

ggsave(plotPath, plot = p, width = 8, height = 6)

} ### End of loop
```
